name: [UPD] Build a REAL House
desc:
🏠 Build a real house from the ground up – solo or with friends!

Dig the pit, pour the concrete, stack the walls, put on the roof, plaster, paint… and finish it with shiny tiles. Every step is hands-on and every house is yours.

🏗️ 7 HOUSES TO BUILD
House • Pool • Villa • Mansion • Riviera Villa • NEW: Sunset • NEW: Estate

⭐ FEATURES
🔨 Satisfying tools with smooth animations (press F to show off yours!)
🏅 Tool Mastery – level up your tools to Bronze, Silver, Gold, Diamond and Rainbow
🖐️ Leave your handprint in the wet concrete
💎 Dig up rare treasures and earn gems
📒 Upgrade your tools in your notebook
🏆 Race the clock – fastest builders get on the leaderboard
👥 Co-op: build together, finish faster

🎮 CONTROLS
Click / hold – use tool • F – inspect tool • Tab – notebook • E – handprint

🆕 UPDATE: 2 new houses – Sunset & Estate, with luxury furniture!

👍 Like the game if you enjoyed building!

llm.loop: dig the pit, pour concrete, stack walls, roof, plaster, paint and tile a house step by step -> earn gems -> upgrade tools -> build bigger houses
llm.objectives: finish all 7 houses, fastest build times
llm.progression: 7 house types, tool mastery tiers Bronze->Rainbow, gems
llm.instructions: use tools to complete each building step, solo or co-op
llm.thumbnails: half-built vs finished mansion split, brick walls under construction
llm.complexity_notes: multi-stage building system with animated tools and several house models
